program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed ?? 4; const gravity = inputs.gravity ?? 9.8; const mass = inputs.mass ?? 1.0; const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(time, (2 * launchSpeed) / gravity)); const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const force = mass * gravity; const acceleration = -gravity; let motionState = "Ready to toss"; const topTime = launchSpeed / gravity; if (t > 0 && t < topTime - 0.02) motionState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - topTime) <= 0.02) motionState = "At the top"; else if (t > topTime + 0.02 && height > 0) motionState = "Falling"; else if (height <= 0 && t > 0) motionState = "Back at launch height"; const pixelsPerMeter = 120; const launchY = 320; const ballY = launchY - height * pixelsPerMeter; const ballX = 180; const lane1 = sdk.panel({ x: 30, y: 50, w: 260, h: 360, title: "The Motion", state: motionState }); const axisY = sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 80, y: 320, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" }); const ballObj = sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 24, { role: "observed" }); const vecV = sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 24, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "v" }); const vecA = sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 24, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "a" }); const calloutLines = [`v: ${velocity.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${acceleration.toFixed(2)} m/s^2`, `Fg: ${force.toFixed(1)} N`]; const calloutObj = sdk.callout(ballX + 55, ballY - 20, calloutLines, { id: "callout.toss" }); const points = sdk.sample((st) => launchSpeed - gravity * st, 0, Math.min(t, (2 * launchSpeed) / gravity), 20); const plotObj = sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 320, y: 50, w: 290, h: 260, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: +5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points.map(([st, sv]) => ({ x: st, y: sv })) }] }); const noteText = sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 340, 330, "Slope a = -g", { role: "neutral" }); const lane2 = sdk.panel({ x: 310, y: 50, w: 310, h: 360, title: "Velocity over Time", state: "v = u - gt" }); const objects = [...lane1, axisY, ballObj, ...vecV, ...vecA, calloutObj, lane2, plotObj, noteText]; const quantities = { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime: topTime, apexHeight: (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity), height, velocity, acceleration, force }; const readouts = [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts }, quantities }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and force remain constant. Mass changes force, not motion.
manifest.description: A side-by-side view showing a tossed ball with live velocity and acceleration vectors on a height ruler, and a velocity-time graph with a slope line.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
